text:
mike: Heads-up — prototype idea: runtime emits an 'embed heartbeat' to the routing layer. Trying to reduce cases where big 1536-dim batches cause soft-quota thrashing and lead router to pick lower-quality routes.
sophia: ok. quick sketch — is this per-tenant, per-route, or per-request? periodic or on-change?
mike: per-active-pipeline (tenant+route). periodic-ish (every ~1s) with a tiny control header tunneled in the mesh. example payload: `load=0.7;avg_dims=1536;pending=12`. Router uses `load` to bias routing (prefer low-latency pool or trigger spillover). Also feeds console telemetry.
rahul: question: is this an infra-internal header or something clients must send? we can't require SDK changes.
mike: infra-internal only (runtime -> router). no client changes. it's pushed from the serving runtime sidecar into the control plane/routing layer.
carla: observability caution — we must guard cardinality. tagging by tenant+route+model is ok but watch metric cardinality in TSDB. rollups/rollup windows required.
observability-bot: metric registered: `embed.heartbeat` with labels {tenant,route,model} emitted when heartbeat.load >= 0.1.
sophia: how does this interact with quota accounting? we currently meter by ingress tokens/dims. if router moves requests, billing must remain exact.
mike: billing unchanged — heartbeat only influences routing/soft throttles. Quota & billing continue to be calculated at preflight/ingress hooks.
rahul: rollout safety: need opt-in and graceful fallback if heartbeat disappears. routers should fall back to existing policy. Also need `decision_reason` logs so we can trace why a request chose a path.
carla: console needs a small panel: `route_heatmap` overlay showing heartbeat load + 95p latency, with a toggle to color decisions that were heartbeat-driven in last 24h. Also an aggregated low-card rollup for weekly trends.
sophia: sampling/telemetry budget? we can't emit every heartbeat for every tenant at high cardinality. propose adaptive sampling: full emit when load > 0.6, otherwise 1/s sampled. include a tiny `dims_hist` summary (buckets: <512,512-1024,1024-2048).
mike: agreed. plan: feature-flagged `embed_heartbeat` behind an opt-in. start with internal-only routes for 2 weeks, then a small percentage of prod routes. runtime will emit seq numbers so we can detect drops.
rahul: add runbook: if we see routing loops or latency regressions, flip feature flag off. routers must log `decision_reason=heartbeat` or `decision_reason=fallback` for postmortem.
carla: will draft the dashboard panels and a rollup query. Also propose an alert: `heartbeat.load > 0.9 for 3m` -> page eng-runtime.
observability-bot: suggested alert rule created: `embed.heartbeat{load>0.9}  for 3m -> page eng-runtime`.
sophia: I can schedule a brief sync tomorrow (runtime + router + billing + observability). thanks all — this looks promising.
mike: sample header format for engineering docs: `X-Embed-Heartbeat: load=0.74;avg_dims=1536;pending=8;seq=17239`
carla: :thumbsup: will add into the dashboard PR and drop a short doc in the eng repo.
